meta.note: Generated artifact — regenerate with node e2e/browser-verification/generate-per-repo.mjs. Run one worker per file for parallel verification.

baselineMetrics.minApiCount: total entry points in apiIndex (HTTP + non-HTTP)
baselineMetrics.minFlowGraphsWithDecision: L5 flows containing >=1 decision node (control-flow depth)
baselineMetrics.minMobileItemCount: mobile screen/nav/network items (0 for backend repos)
baselineMetrics.minAnonymousResolutionRate: fraction of anonymous route handlers resolved to a named symbol

mandates: ALL REPOS: every applicable case runs against EVERY repo in `repoCatalog` (see `applicabilityRules` for how a case maps to repo categories/kinds). A case is not 'done' until it has evidence for each applicable repo.

SCREENSHOT EVERY TEST: every case MUST capture a screenshot and record an explicit ACTUAL-vs-EXPECTED visual observation — DOM/db/log/network checks are ADDITIONAL evidence, never a substitute for the screenshot. See `evidenceProtocol`.
TOOL CALLS INCLUDED: the MCP tool-call surface is a first-class dimension (suite `TOOLS`), exercised on the MCP build via JSON-RPC tools/call; each tool call also records expected-vs-actual output.

OUTPUT TO BUILD-NUMBERED tmp/: every test's evidence (screenshot, expected, actual, analysis, run-state) is written under `tmp/verification-runs/<build>/...` inside the repo. `tmp/` is already git-ignored (.gitignore), publish-ignored (.vscodeignore `tmp/**`), and VS Code-hidden (.vscode/settings.json).

preRunReset.rule: BEFORE every repo run: `git -C <repoPath> checkout -- .` + `git -C <repoPath> clean -fd` to restore the repo to its ORIGINAL committed state (undo probe/feature files from prior runs). No run starts from a dirty tree. Then re-init + resync and capture the perf baseline (SETUP-04). After the run, reset again to drop probe files.
steps: re-init (time it, assert distributed for multi-repo, non-zero counts)
git checkout/clean again to clean up probe files

screenshot.appliesTo: EVERY case in EVERY suite (including TOOLS)
screenshot.rule: Capture at least one screenshot of the actual rendered state; multi-step cases capture before + after (NN-<label>.png). A case without a screenshot is INCOMPLETE regardless of other evidence.

actualVsExpected.rule: OBSERVE the screenshot, write actual.md, then analysis.md with an explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict comparing actual to expected. DOM/db/log/network/perf checks are ADDITIONAL — they never replace the screenshot observation.

bothBuilds.rule: For cases with builds:['vsix','mcp'], capture a screenshot on EACH build (:7742 and :7842) and note parity in analysis.md.

toolCallEvidence.rule: TOOLS cases save the raw JSON-RPC request+response to evidence/network.json; when the tool drives a view (get_tour/get_impact_analysis/get_feature_pack/etc.), ALSO screenshot the rendered result.

onFailure.rule: On FAIL: keep the failing screenshot, capture the ext-host/daemon log tail, and write a ticket line (repro + finish-line + test scenario) into analysis.md AND the repo ISSUES.md.

diagramOpenMs.note: Render-only open of an already-built diagram (L1/L2b). 10-15s = a rebuild/grind bug.

reinitMultiRepoMs.note: Distributed re-init of polar (4 repos). Must NOT route to monolithic syncOrchestrator.

extHostIdleCpuPct.note: After init/resync settles; a pegged core + climbing RSS = synchronous O(n^2) / grind.

routeTemplates.description: Repo-specific routes in cases are examples; substitute per-repo entities discovered at run time.

priority.P0: Core drill-down / stability / data-correctness — a failure blocks release.
priority.P1: Important feature correctness — a failure is a shipping bug.

toolCatalog.description: MCP tool-call surface exercised by suite TOOLS on the MCP build (JSON-RPC: initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call). Names extracted from src/mcp/mcp-tools.ts. Hidden tools (AGENT_HIDDEN_TOOLS) are exercised via tools/call directly even though they are not in the default agent-facing tools/list.
toolCatalog.howToCall: node dist/mcp-server.js <repo> over stdio; JSON-RPC: {method:'initialize'} -> {method:'tools/list'} -> {method:'tools/call', params:{name, arguments}}. Or via the connected client (claude mcp add <name> -- node dist/mcp-server.js <repo>).
toolCatalog.argValidation: callToolHandler validates required args (MCP-EVAL-3) — a missing required arg returns isError with 'missing required argument', not a crash.
